answer: A marketplace for timber estimates, pigment recipes and vine disease reports can make each worker post a refundable performance bond before taking a job. Random auditors compare delivered evidence with hidden reference cases; proven fabrication burns the bond, while honest completion returns it. Extra identities each need their own bond, so a Sybil farm ties up capital and risks losing it for every false claim. Bonds cannot prove unique ownership, wealthy attackers can afford many, and mistaken audits need an appeal process to protect honest workers.
